action_description: a fast twin-katar slashing combo: the right arm swings a wide sweeping horizontal slash across the body, then the left arm swings a wide sweeping slash back the other way, light quick steps, the headband and cloth tails whipping, then back to a ready stance with both katars raised; very fast, sharp, flashy; no stabbing, no crossed arms, no X slash; no effects, no slash trails, no dust
